title: Banks Act Circular C2/2020 — Classification of the Land and Agricultural Development Bank of South Africa (Land Bank) bills under the liquidity coverage ratio framework
enablingLegislation: Section 6(4) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990)

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: This circular is issued by the Prudential Authority in terms of Section 6(4) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Classification of the Land and Agricultural Development Bank of South Africa (Land Bank) bills under the liquidity coverage ratio framework.

sections.heading: Application
sections.text: This circular applies to all banks, branches of foreign institutions and controlling companies registered or operating in South Africa in terms of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Classification of the Land and Agricultural Development Bank of South Africa (Land Bank) bills under the liquidity coverage ratio framework.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: Classification of the Land and Agricultural Development Bank of South Africa (Land Bank) bills under the liquidity coverage ratio framework. Institutions are required to ensure compliance with the requirements set out herein. This circular remains effective as confirmed in Banks Act Circular 1 of the relevant year.
